screenshots.name: Ordinary Release 1.0/24 menu
screenshots.rootVisualVerdict: approved; expected ordinary main menu

reviewNotes: Gold destination borders/cost badges and the canonical dashed staged route remain readable over the sea and cosmetic mist. The dock states remaining and voyage cost without needing Fleet.
Painted harvest texture follows existing inset/grout/token geometry and is intact at local, World and maximum zoom. Maximum zoom deliberately clips other board elements at the viewport boundary.
Settlement/city headings distinguish one/two resources; city partial progress remains 1 of2 after cold resume. Largest text retains heading/progress/confirmation and uses a scrollable choices region.
Rival notice is visibly Alexander traded with Ramesses; human hand keeps one Grain. Human winner shows ordinary exact exchange receipt.

Three informational caption captures are retained as accessibility measurements, not substitute screenshots of a complete gameplay state. Native raw contrast flags retain their exact-ID/live>=7:1 qualification.
Ordinary Release menu is separately attributed from Debug QA game captures.
